aggregateForWithdrawal(address,address,u.details: Aggregate multiple L2-only UTXOs and create an Exit UTXO for withdrawal This allows users to withdraw any amount (up to their total balance) by: 1. Aggregating all their L2-only UTXOs 2. Creating an "Exit UTXO" for the withdrawal amount 3. Creating a "Change UTXO" for remaining balance (stays on L2) The Exit UTXO will be registered on L1 by the operator, enabling withdrawal.
